findings.current: Jin Taekyung stepped into the pool of blood and forced his feet to move.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Jin rises before taking a reluctant step.
findings.rationale: 일어난 means he got up; 떨어지지 않은 발걸음을 뗐다 describes a step he struggled to take.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung rose, stepping in the pool of blood, and forced himself to take a step.
findings.source: 피 웅덩이를 밟으며 일어난 진태경은 떨어지지 않은 발걸음을 뗐다.

findings.current: The two characters never quite made it past his tongue. Jin Taekyung silently turned them over in his mind, like bear gall.
findings.defect: “Two characters” refers to the Korean spelling, not the English title; “like bear gall” leaves the image’s bitterness unclear.
findings.rationale: The name remains unspoken, and 곱씹었다 evokes chewing over the bitter thought.
findings.replacement: The name hovered on the tip of his tongue, never spoken. Jin Taekyung silently chewed it over, bitter as bear gall.
findings.source: 차마 소리가 되어 흘러나오지 못한 채 혀끝에서만 맴도는 그 두 글자를, 진태경은 곰의 쓸개처럼 조용히 곱씹었다.

findings.current: But the darkness cast by the two characters *Dark Heaven* was deeper and denser than any of them.
findings.defect: The English name is not two characters.
findings.rationale: 두 글자 describes the Korean name’s written form; the image of its shadow does not depend on that count.
findings.replacement: But the darkness cast by the name *Dark Heaven* was deeper and denser than any of them.
findings.source: 그러나 암천(暗天)이라는 두 글자가 드리운 어둠은 그 무엇보다 깊고 짙었고

findings.current: At the head of countless people and horses—thousands of them—a group roared as if coughing up blood, their torn flags whipping fiercely in the wind.
findings.defect: The draft changes the single torn banner into multiple flags and shifts the waving action from the group to the flags.
findings.rationale: 깃발 is singular here, and the group is waving it.
findings.replacement: At the head of thousands of people and horses, a group fiercely waved a torn banner and roared as if coughing up blood.
findings.source: 물경 수천을 아우르는 무수한 인마의 선두에서, 찢어진 깃발을 맹렬하게 휘날리며 피를 토하듯 부르짖는 일단의 무리를.

findings.current: Their flags billowed in the wind as they advanced.
findings.defect: The draft again makes the single banner plural.
findings.rationale: The source continues to refer to one 깃발 accompanying the group.
findings.replacement: The banner billowed in the wind as it advanced with them.
findings.source: 바람을 타고 나부끼는 깃발이 그들과 함께 나아간다.

summary: The draft preserves the central Teleport deduction. Action and banner details need correction; two literal renderings of Korean character counts read unnaturally in English.
